newsitem.title: USA: Resource Bancshares to buy Meritage.
newsitem.headline: Resource Bancshares to buy Meritage.

text.p: Resource Bancshares Mortgage Group Inc said Tuesday it signed an "exclusive" letter of intent to acquire Meritage Mortgage Corp.

The company said it will exchange about $2.0 million of cash and 926,000 shares of its common stock for all the outstanding common stock of Meritage. It said its issue of about 427,000 of the 926,000 shares was contingent upon Meritage achieving higher levels of subprime mortgage production in the 30 months following the closing of the deal.
The closing is set to occur in the first quarter of 1997.
Based in Portland, Oregon, Meritage produced about $107 million of subprime mortgage loans in 1996.
Resource Bancshares Mortgage Group Inc is a mortgage banker.
